page.overview:
Who is Charge?

Charge, also known as Lexon in Germany, is an Alpha Team minifigure first introduced in a 2000 video game before making a physical debut in 2001.

In the 5714 LEGO Alpha Team PC game, Charge wears a black jumpsuit, with the right side of his torso being colored blue. He has the Alpha Team logo on the left side of his torso, a power cable slung over his right shoulder, and a battery and charge meter strapped to his belt. His right sleeve is bright blue. His legs feature textured pads on his hips, thighs, and shins, along with a blue stripe along his right side. He has black hair shaped as a crew cut. His face is textured with sunglasses, sideburns, a mustache, a goatee, stubble, and a headset with a microphone.

When Charge made his physical debut in 2001, his minifigure design was based upon his video game model with some changes. His torso print was slightly modified, removing the power cable and changing the yellow/black stripes on the battery to blue/grey. His thigh pads have been changed to pockets. His hair is represented by a Mini Wig Man, despite the same theme also featuring the newly-introduced Mini Wig, Crewcut.

Charge's Mission Deep Sea variant retains much of his 2001 minifigure design, with the most notable changes being switching black to earth blue and different leg printing that matches other Alpha Team agents in the subtheme. He wears dark grey Mini Crash Helmet with a transparent blue Divers Mask, with his black Mini Wig Man supplied as an alternative hair piece. A promotional image depicts him with a dark grey oxygen tank, but this is not included in Charge's only set within this subtheme.
